1.w: A Prayer of one afflicted, when he grows weak and pours out his complaint before YHWH. O YHWH, may You hear my prayer and may my cry come to You!

2.w: Do not hide Your face from me, in the day of distress for me! Incline to me Your ear; on the day [that] I call may You hurry and answer me!

3.w: For my days come to an end like smoke, and my bones like a burning [wick] have been charred.

4.w: My heart has been struck like the grass and has withered, [so] that I forget to eat my bread.

5.w: From the voice of my groaning, my bone has clung to my flesh.

6.w: I am like a vulture of the desert; I have become like an owl of the wasteland.

7.w: I stay awake, and I am like a bird alone on the housetop.

8.w: All the day my enemies the taunt me; those shouting boastfully swear against me.

9.w: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and my drink I have mingled with weeping,

10.w: from the face of Your anger and Your wrath, for You have lifted me up and cast me away.

11.w: My days [are] like a shadow stretching out; and I, like the grass, wither away.

12.w: But You, O YHWH, dwell forever, and Your memorial to generation and generation.

13.w: You will rise up [and] have compassion [on] Zion—for the time to show her favor, indeed, the appointed time, has come.

14.w: How Your servants take delight [in] her stones—even her dust they favor!

15.w: And the nations will fear the name of YHWH, and all the kings of the earth Your glory.

16.w: For YHWH has built up Zion; He has appeared in His glory.

17.w: He has turned toward the prayer of the destitute, and He will not despise their prayer.

18.w: This will be written for the generation to come, and a people yet to be created will praise YAH.

19.w: For He looked down from the height of His sanctuary, YHWH looked out from the heavens to the earth,

20.w: to hear the groaning of the prisoner, to release the sons of death;

21.w: to declare in Zion the name of YHWH, and His praise in Jerusalem,

22.w: in the gathering of the peoples together—and the kingdoms—to serve YHWH.

23.w: He has broken my strength on the way; He has shortened my days.

24.w: I said, “O my God, do not take me up in the midst of my days; Your years [are] generation [to] generations.

25.w: Before time You founded the earth, and the heavens [are] the work of Your hands.

26.w: They will perish, but You will stand; and all of them will wear out like a garment—like clothing, You will pass them on, and they will pass away.

27.w: And You are the same, and Your years will not end.

28.w: The sons of Your servants will settle down, and their seed will be established before Your face.”
